experiences.name: Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel
experiences.description: Explore one of the world's greatest art collections, culminating in Michelangelo's breathtaking Sistine Chapel ceiling. Book skip-the-line tickets in advance to maximize your time among Renaissance masterpieces.

experiences.name: Trastevere Food Walking Tour
experiences.description: Join a guided culinary walk through the charming Trastevere neighborhood, sampling supplì, artisanal gelato, Roman-style pizza al taglio, and local wines at family-run trattorias and street food stalls.

experiences.name: Borghese Gallery Art Experience
experiences.description: Visit the intimate Borghese Gallery housing Bernini sculptures and Caravaggio paintings in a stunning villa setting. Reservations are mandatory and timed, making it an exclusive and unhurried art experience.

experiences.name: Campo de' Fiori Market & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Start at the vibrant Campo de' Fiori morning market to select fresh local ingredients, then join a hands-on cooking class nearby to learn how to prepare classic Roman dishes like cacio e pepe and tiramisu.
experiences.location: Campo de' Fiori, Centro Storico, Rome

experiences.name: Palatine Hill & Roman Forum Self-Guided Art & History Walk
experiences.description: Wander through the ancient Roman Forum and Palatine Hill, discovering frescoes, mosaics, and ancient sculptures in situ. A combined ticket offers incredible artistic and historical value in the heart of Rome.
experiences.location: Palatine Hill & Roman Forum, Ancient Rome district, Rome
